typography.headings: Use 'font-display' (Outfit/Unbounded) for headings. Keep it bold (`font-bold` or `font-black`) and use tight tracking (`tracking-tight` or `tracking-tighter`). Ensure text sizes cap at text-6xl for hero.
typography.body: Use 'font-manrope' (Manrope) for body and smaller text for legibility in dense dashboards.
typography.labels_overlines: Use uppercase + tiny + wide spacing (`text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em]`) for overlines like 'LATEST ORDERS' or 'COMMUNITY CHAT'.

colors.base_background: Very dark forest green, almost black. Use `#08120B` or `#051307`. Never use pure `#000000`.
colors.surface_cards: Deep Pine green (`#0D2B12` or `emerald-950/40`). Use for cards, panels, sidebars.
colors.accents: Neon emerald (`emerald-400` / `#34d399` and `emerald-500` / `#10b981`) for buttons, active links, and positive deltas.
colors.text: Bone white (`#F3F4F6` or `gray-100`) for primary text. Muted sage (`emerald-100/50` or `gray-400`) for secondary text.

visual enhancers.glassmorphism: For sticky header and right sidebar chat: `backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#08120B]/70 border-b border-emerald-900/30`. Add a 1px subtle inner stroke.
visual enhancers.tracing_beam: Use a shimmering border on the center hero card. A `mask-image` or subtle linear-gradient border.
visual enhancers.glow_effects: Use `drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(16,185,129,0.3)]` on primary CTAs and active numbers.
visual enhancers.texture: Apply a subtle grain texture (`bg-noise` or `.grain` class) over the hero background to avoid flat color.

grids.guest_landing: High density bento. Large screens: `grid-cols-12 gap-6`. Left (Latest Orders) `col-span-3`, Center (Hero) `col-span-6`, Right (Chat) `col-span-3`. On medium screens, stack right chat or turn into FAB. On mobile: `grid-cols-1` with center hero first, then orders, then chat.
grids.dashboard: Strict dense hierarchy. Use a left/bottom responsive nav. Main content in `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4`.

layouts.guest_landing: Three-column preview setup. Left and Right columns should have an 'endless scroll' or 'live feed' look with gradient fade-outs at bottom (`mask-image: linear-gradient(to bottom, black 80%, transparent)`). Center is the main CTA with generous `p-8` or `p-12`.
layouts.modals: Auth modals should use sharp/semi-rounded cards (`rounded-xl` or `rounded-2xl`). Split layout if possible, or centered sleek form with glassmorphism over the dark green background. Do NOT blur the whole page, use `bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm` for overlay.
layouts.header: Sticky top `z-50`, flex-between. Always has background (glass). Must contain Logo, LanguagePicker, SignIn/SignUp.
layouts.dashboard_shell: App-style layout. Top nav with Balance Pill (USD/EUR). Side/bottom nav for route switching.

motion.hover_states: Buttons must lift slightly (`-translate-y-[1px]`) with increased shadow. Menu items shift right (`translate-x-1`).
motion.modals: Fade in and slide up slightly (`animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-4 duration-300`).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over emerald buttons is dark (`text-emerald-950`). Ensure text over dark backgrounds is light (`text-white` or `text-gray-200`).
accessibility.focus: Focus states must use `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-[#08120B]`.
accessibility.test_attributes: All buttons, inputs, modals, and list items MUST retain existing and add new `data-testid` (e.g. `data-testid='sign-in-btn'`, `data-testid='latest-order-item'`).

media.hero_background: Use the abstract emerald texture loosely blended into the hero center background with low opacity (`opacity-20` and `mix-blend-luminosity`).

3d libraries.decision: No heavy 3D libraries (R3F/D3) needed for this specific problem statement as performance and SaaS utility is prioritized. Use CSS animations and Lucide icons.

hero_texture.description: Abstract green and white crystalline pattern. Use as a masked, low-opacity background for the center hero card.

instructions_to_main_agent: Retain existing state contracts and endpoints. The refresh is strictly visual and UX.

Ensure GuestLanding keeps the 3-column layout (Latest Orders, Hero, Live Chat). Use `grid-cols-1` mobile to `grid-cols-12` large screens and bento-box aesthetics. Make the feed panels look 'live' and technical.
Design the AuthModals (Sign in, Sign up, Forgot password) directly inside the GuestLanding or ClientDashboard shell where they currently exist. Apply glassmorphism and sharp emerald borders.
For the signed-in ClientDashboard, style the top nav with the Balance pill (tap to toggle) and side/bottom nav structure clearly. Maintain all specific nav items (Home, Purchase, Games, etc.).

Use emerald/green explicitly in Tailwind classes (e.g. `bg-emerald-500`, `text-emerald-400`, `border-emerald-900/40`) to ensure consistency, avoiding reliance strictly on the `.theme-green` color rewrites unless necessary.
Do NOT use pure black or white backgrounds. Use #08120B for base, #0D2B12 for cards.
Do NOT hide desktop navigation inside a hamburger menu. The sidebar should be visible on desktop, converting to a bottom nav on mobile.
Ensure `data-testid` is added to ALL interactive elements (forms, toggles, buttons, list items).
Implement the math captcha directly where it currently exists with clear input states.
Take playwright screenshots (1400x800) of `/client/dashboard` (logged out) and the sign-in modal as requested.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate. DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds behind text.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. `transition: all`).
You MUST NOT center align the app container in CSS.
Use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, transitions).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, and custom selection states elevate the design.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters for icons. Use Lucide or Radix icons.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Follow 'Tactical Forest' archetype. Use dark forest backgrounds with high-contrast emerald neon accents for CTAs and data indicators.
Never center-align large blocks of text; stick to crisp left-alignment for all data feeds and body copy.
Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all text elements. Use text-shadow over complex backgrounds.
